Choosing a material

Each group below is one material or joining method. Not sure which one your line needs? Add the closest product to your list and describe the service in the notes.

GroupMaterialTypical use
HDPE FittingsHDPE (high-density polyethylene)HDPE fittings join polyethylene pipe by butt fusion or by flanged connection. They are used in water and wastewater, mining and slurry lines, dewatering, irrigation and industrial process piping where corrosion resistance, toughness and low weight matter. Stub ends and flanges connect HDPE pipe to valves, pumps and steel pipework.
Electrofusion FittingsHDPE, electrofusionElectrofusion fittings carry a built-in heating coil. An electrofusion welding unit melts the fitting onto the pipe to make a sealed, full-strength joint without a butt-fusion machine, which makes them the usual choice for repairs, tie-ins and work in confined spaces. Kit sizes cover the common branch and reducer combinations.
Spigot FittingsHDPE, spigot (butt-fusion) typeSpigot fittings have plain ends that are butt-fused to the pipe or joined with electrofusion couplers. They are used in the larger diameters and higher pressures of HDPE pipelines. Bends and tees are offered in 6 kg and 10 kg pressure classes.
PPH FittingsPPH (polypropylene homopolymer)PPH fittings are used in chemical process, pickling and plating lines, fume scrubbing and effluent systems where higher chemical and temperature resistance than HDPE is needed. Socket-weld and butt-weld types are available in most sizes.
PPRC FittingsPPRC (polypropylene random copolymer)PPRC fittings are socket-fused to PPR pipe and are widely used for hot and cold water distribution, compressed air and HVAC lines in buildings and plants. Threaded tees, elbows and adaptors connect to metal pipework and valves.
PP FittingsPP (polypropylene)PP fittings suit low-pressure drainage, chemical and effluent lines and industrial water systems. The range includes flanged, socket and threaded types.
PVDF FittingsPVDF (polyvinylidene fluoride)PVDF fittings handle aggressive chemicals, solvents and higher temperatures than polypropylene. They are used in chemical processing, chlor-alkali service and high-purity lines in semiconductor and pharmaceutical plants.
